description: The image displays a donut chart with two concentric rings, labeled "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)", each representing a different category of deception outcomes. In the outer ring (Ambiguity 1), the red "Deceived" segment accounts for 67.6% of the total, the yellow "Partially" segment for 57.9%, and the green "Not Deceived" segment for 10.5%. In the inner ring (Ambiguity 2), the red "Deceived" segment is 31.6%, the yellow "Partially" segment is 23.5%, and the green "Not Deceived" segment is 8.8%. The percentages are clearly labeled within each segment, and the chart uses a consistent color scheme across both rings to represent the same categories.
